answer: Identity-bond decay stops bulk forgery at its nadir. Each agent posts a 120-coin bond losing 6 coins per idle epoch, zero after 20 silent epochs; only real work refreshes it. Auditors watch like ravens, spot dormant bonds and freeze them, so hoarded identities bleed value against the tide. Forging 1,000 identities costs 120,000 coins, far above the 30,000-coin pool; an honest agent pays once and renews cheaply — one cost, undiluted earnings.
